battle.name: 朔州、黑山之戰
battle.brief: 儀鳳四年（679）秋，契丹部眾自黑山方向南下，一支寇朔州，唐軍據城固守並遣騎擊退之。卡面羅馬短劍為前1世紀羅馬步兵的標準近戰兵器，與本役相隔約八百年，並未出現在戰場上；同期唐邊軍近身靠環首刀與唐刀，契丹部眾則用短刀與角弓。

kit.name: 羅馬短劍
kit.history: 刺劍不是用來揮砍的。短兵相接靠的是盾的邊緣和刺突的節奏。

countries: 朔州、黑山之戰是唐高宗儀鳳四年（679）北方邊線上的一場邊戰，交戰一方是唐朝的邊軍體系，另一方是契丹部眾。所謂「黑山」，史籍所指不夠明確，一說指朔州以北陰山山系中的黑山，與契丹早期活動的松山、黑水一帶相連；另一說指更北側契丹諸部落的居地。諸說並存，現已難以確指，因此這場戰役的地理只能作到「北方邊線」這個層次。 唐朝方面，朔州是北方邊州之一，治所在善陽，與靈武、定襄、雲中諸州連成一條北線防禦帶；州內設有折衝府、兵馬與遊騎，駐軍一部分是關中、中原調來的府兵與募兵，一部分是沿邊的部曲與內附的突厥、契丹人，編制上由節度使、都督一級的將領分段節制，朝廷在長安以中書門下遙度，儀鳳年間北線的部署多由行軍大總管與邊州的長史、兵馬使分擔。契丹方面，這時仍是部落聯盟的形態，沒有穩定的王權與常備軍，兵源是各部的部眾，裝備以角弓、骨鏃箭、馬匹與短刀為主，作戰方式是小股騎隊出沒、劫掠牲畜與人口，然後立刻退回草原。由於缺乏專傳，這場戰役的交戰細節在《舊唐書》《新唐書》與《資治通鑑》裡都只是簡略帶過，可上陣兵員、編制與勝負經過，沒有留下可信的數字。
countriesEn: The battle of Shuozhou and Heishan was a frontier engagement fought on the northern line of the Tang empire in the fourth year of Yifeng (679). One side was the Tang border establishment, the other the Khitan tribal host. The exact place meant by "Heishan" is not firmly fixed in the surviving records: one reading takes it to mean a Heishan in the Yin Mountains range north of Shuozhou, connected with the Songshan-Heishui country where the early Khitans moved; another takes it further north, into the seat of the Khitan clans themselves. The two readings stand side by side and cannot now be settled, so the campaign can only be placed geographically at the level of "the northern frontier line." On the Tang side, Shuozhou was one of the northern border prefectures, its seat at Shanyang, and it formed part of a continuous northern defence belt running through Lingwu, Dingxiang and Yunchun. The prefecture maintained a Training Directorate, cavalry and mounted patrol units; part of the garrison was infantry and recruited soldiers sent up from Guanzhong and the Central Plain, part was local militia households and enrolled Turks and Khitans, and command was divided among jiedushi and dudu-level officers, with the court in Chang'an directing by written order through the Secretariat. In the Yifeng years the northern line was largely handled by generals-at-large together with the local prefectural commanders and the officers in charge of troops. On the Khitan side, the confederacy still had no settled kingship or standing army; its strength was the fighting men of the individual clans, armed with composite bows, bone-tipped arrows, horses and short knives, and operating in small mounted bands that raided for livestock and people before falling back onto the steppe. Because there is no dedicated biography, the details of the fighting are only glancingly touched in the Old and New Tang histories and in the Comprehensive Mirror; the number of men who actually fought, the exact order of battle and the course of the engagement have left no reliable figures behind.
people: 留下姓名的將領不多，這是這場戰役在史料上的真實面貌。就唐廷而言，儀鳳年間北線上可考的人物主要是幾位身兼邊防的重臣：薛仁貴在青海一線同吐蕃相持，名義上統著北方兵柄；裴行儉在同一年西出碎葉、生擒西突厥都支，說明唐廷把新銳將領分置在東、西兩條戰線，一邊求穩，一邊求勝；真正守在朔州城頭與烽堠之間的，是中層的邊州長史、兵馬使與折衝府校尉，這些人的名字多散見於《資治通鑑》儀鳳四年的零星記載裏。契丹方面，這一時期的部首領在史書中或記作「契丹大首領」，或只以單名、綽號的音譯出現，與《舊唐書·北狄傳》《新唐書·北狄傳》以及後來《遼史》追述的契丹祖先名號並不能一一對應；任何把某一個後世記載中的契丹首領指為本役主將的說法，都屬於臆測。無論如何記載，邊地戰役中真正決定勝負的往往不是個人武勇，而是守城將官、校尉與屯丁之間的配合，以及烽燧傳警之後各州按約出動的默契。史載有限，本節只能列出可核的框架人物，朔州與黑山兩處的實際領兵者，諸說並存，暫不強指。
peopleEn: Few commanders are named, and that is the true state of this campaign in the historical record. On the Tang side, the figures verifiable for the northern line in the Yifeng years are mostly high officers who also held frontier responsibilities: Xue Rengui was locked in stalemate with the Tibetans along the Qinghai front and formally held the northern command; in the very same year Pei Xingjian marched west to Suyab and captured the Western Turkic ruler Du Zhi, which shows that the court deployed its best new generals on two separate fronts, one held steady and one pressed for victory. The men who actually stood on the walls of Shuozhou and between the beacon towers were the middling sort of officers, prefectural commanders, officers in charge of troops and drill instructors of the Training Directorates, whose names survive only in scattered notices in the Comprehensive Mirror for the fourth year of Yifeng. On the Khitan side, the clan chiefs of this period appear in the histories either as "the great chief of the Khitans" or only as transliterated single names and nicknames, and they cannot be matched one to one with the ancestor names preserved in the northern border chapters of the Old and New Tang histories or recalled much later in the History of Liao; any attempt to designate one of them as the commander in this battle is guesswork. Whatever the records say, the outcome of a frontier action was rarely decided by individual valour. It was decided by the cooperation between the garrison commander, the drill officers and the enrolled farmers, and by the punctuality with which the neighbouring prefectures moved out after a beacon signal. The record here is thin, so only a verified frame of personalities can be given; the actual leaders at Shuozhou and at Heishan remain a matter of competing readings and are not forced here.
kits: 卡面兵器是羅馬短劍（Gladius），約公元前1世紀已是羅馬步兵的標準配備：雙刃、短身、握柄有突鍔，配圓形小盾，刺擊靠的是握柄的節奏與盾的邊緣，而不是揮砍的力道。它是前1世紀地中海世界短兵相接的標誌性器物，也是「以刺代砍」這套辦法的源頭。史載有限的是，這件兵器並沒有出現在679年的北方邊戰，它與本役相隔約八百年，在中國的戰場上不可能存在，作為卡面，它只標示一種近戰原理的源頭。真正在朔州、黑山一線服役的是唐邊軍的裝備：遠射以角弓、弩與長槊為主，攻城與守城有櫓、飛石、撞車與雲梯，壘壁與烽燧串成一線；近戰是環首刀與唐刀這類直刃、單邊、有格的刀，步卒結陣時配盾，騎兵用長槊突刺、馬上佩橫刀。契丹與突厥部眾的裝備以角弓、骨鏃箭、短刀與套馬的繩索為主，甲胄是皮甲與札甲，鎧甲比例遠低於唐軍，重裝幾乎只出現在少數頭目身上。雙方的差距不在刀劍，而在馬匹數量、弓的射速與能否在攻守之間迅速轉換。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman gladius, standard kit for a Roman infantryman by about the first century BC: a double-edged blade with a short blade, a pommel with a distinct grip stop, and a small round shield. It was thrust rather than swung, the rhythm of the wrist and the rim of the shield doing the work in close combat. It is the emblematic side-arm of the Mediterranean world in the first century BC and the point of origin of the principle of stabbing instead of cutting. What must be said plainly is that this weapon did not appear in the northern frontier fighting of 679; it stands about eight centuries away from that campaign and could not have existed on a Chinese battlefield, and on the card it stands only as the origin point of a way of fighting at close quarters. What actually served on the Shuozhou and Heishan line were the arms of the Tang border troops: at range, composite bows, crossbows and long lances; for attack and defence of works, mantlets, stone-throwers, battering rams and scaling ladders, with palisades and beacon towers strung into a single line. At close quarters, the Tang carried ring-pommel knives and Tang-style sabres, straight-edged, single-edged, with a guard, while infantry fought in formation behind shields and cavalry used the long lance for the charge with a single-edged sabre at the saddle. The Khitans and Turks used composite bows, bone-tipped arrows, short knives and ropes for catching horses, with leather and lamellar armour and a far lower proportion of mail than the Tang could field. The real difference between the two sides lay not in blades at all, but in the number of horses, the rate of fire of the bow, and whether a force could shift between attacking and being attacked.
tactics: 北方邊戰的戰術由地形決定多於由兵種決定。朔州治所在今山西朔城一帶，踞守河套與太行山之間的通道，北面是廣袤的草原與丘陵，這正是契丹騎隊最擅長的地形：來去成鋒，避實擊虛，劫掠完就走，逼唐軍分兵追擊。唐邊軍的應對有一套固定辦法：其一是以城為主，不在野外跟騎隊拼消耗，把入侵者拉進城下弩、弓與飛石的射程，用遠射兵器削其鋒芒；其二是以守代攻，邊軍騎隊不遠追，只在幾處路口、水源與草場設伏，或以數百騎輪番逼近，迫敵在原地逗留，消耗其人馬與隨行牲畜；其三是聯防，朔州與雲中、定襄、靈武之間以烽燧傳警，一處遇警，鄰州按約出動，形成梯次的策應；其四是屯田，邊州設屯田戶，兵糧不全然靠後方運，戰時的補給線因此可以拉得比想像中短。城下的短兵相接只在守軍出城反擊、或者敵軍破壞了外圍堡柵的短時間內發生，規模不大，時間也很短。
tacticsEn: On the northern frontier, tactics were determined by the ground far more than by the arms themselves. The seat of Shuozhou, in what is now Shuocheng in Shanxi, commands the corridor between the Hetao and the Taihang range, with open steppe and rolling hills to the north, exactly the country favoured by Khitan mounted bands: strike as a solid group, avoid what is held firmly, hit what is soft, and withdraw the moment the raiding is done, forcing the Tang to chase and therefore to split. The border troops had a fixed set of answers. First, they fought from the city: they refused to trade blows with mounted bands in the open, pulled the raiders down into the range of crossbows, bows and stone-throwers, and spent shot and missiles on the leading edge of the enemy. Second, they turned defence into the weapon: the mounted patrols did not pursue far, but took up positions at fords, water holes and grazing grounds, or pressed in relays of several hundred horse to hold the enemy in one place and grind down their men and their animals. Third, they tied the line together: Shuozhou, Yunchun, Dingxiang and Lingwu were linked by beacon towers, so that an alarm in one place brought out the neighbouring prefecture by the agreed arrangement, forming a echelon of mutual support. Fourth, they fed the troops locally: border prefectures ran military farms, so not every grain came from the rear, and the supply line in wartime could therefore be much shorter than it looks on paper. Close fighting in earnest happened only in short spells, when a garrison sortie came out, or when raiders had broken the outer palisades, and it was small in scale and brief in duration.
data: 可核的數字有限，這一點必須先說明。戰事在唐高宗儀鳳四年，即公元679年；朔州是北方邊州，治所在善陽，自長安經河東、太原北上至朔州的驛程約一千五百里，唐一大里約合今五百五十米上下，換算成今制約八百餘公里。北方沿線的常備部署，官方文牘常以「兵若干萬」形容，但這類數目往往連家口與屯丁一併計入，不等於能上陣的兵員；這一役實際出動多少人，正史沒有留下可信記載，合理的猜測也只是「以州兵與遊騎為主，數千之眾」這個量級。契丹方面的戰時投入同樣無數可考，從其活動方式可推知以數十至數百騎的小隊為單位，不可能一次投入大軍。時間方面只能從「秋」的節令推斷，戰役延續多久、是否反覆侵擾，都無記載。距離上，黑山的方位仍有爭議：若指朔州以北的陰山山系，直線不過數百里，落在遊騎活動的半徑之內；若指更北的松山黑水一帶，則已超出唐軍常規巡界，須由幽州方向出動，行程要加倍。除了年份與年號，任何精確的斬首數、俘虜數、受損器械數都不宜引用。
dataEn: Verifiable numbers are few, and that has to be said first. The fighting falls in the fourth year of Yifeng, which is 679 CE. Shuozhou was a northern border prefecture with its seat at Shanyang; the courier road from Chang'an through Hedong and Taiyuan to Shuozhou ran roughly fifteen hundred li, a Tang great li being about 550 metres today, which converts to a little over eight hundred kilometres. Documents describing the standing garrisons of the northern line habitually speak of "so many tens of thousands of troops", but such tallies generally absorb households and registered farm-workers along with the men, and are not a headcount of men who could fight; no reliable figure for the troops actually committed in this action survives in the official histories, and the most defensible guess is the scale of a prefecture garrison with its patrols, in the low thousands. The Khitan commitment cannot be counted at all, though the shape of their operations suggests bands of a few dozen to a few hundred horse rather than any massed force. On timing, only the season can be given, autumn; how long the action lasted and whether it was repeated are simply not recorded. On distance, the position of Heishan remains disputed: if it is the Heishan of the Yin Mountains north of Shuozhou, it lies a few hundred li away, well inside the working radius of mounted patrols; if it is the Songshan-Heishui country further north, it is beyond the Tang's normal patrol boundary and would have to be reached from the direction of Youzhou, doubling the journey. Apart from the year and the reign title, no exact figure for kills, captives or damaged equipment should be quoted.
cause: 一場邊戰之所以打起來，通常是三層原因疊在一起。最外層是結構性的：唐初平定突厥、置單于都護府之後，北方邊線的格局是「以城控塞」——用州城、軍鎮與屯田把游牧部眾擋在內地之外，同時用互市、羈縻與內附分化去爭取中間地帶。這套辦法有效，但成本高、彈性小，一旦遇上收成不好或者部眾內訌的年份，邊防就會被同時拉向兩頭，一頭要守城，一頭要出兵。第二層是當年的直接背景：儀鳳年間唐廷在青海、涼州一線同吐蕃拉鋸，裴行儉又奉命西行護送薩珊王朝的王子歸國，兵馬與注意力被抽往西線，北方與東北的契丹便趁隙而入，這種節奏在《資治通鑑》儀鳳四年的邊事記載中可以讀出來。第三層是部落經濟的季節性壓力：契丹部眾的畜牧在夏秋之間需要轉移馬群與部眾到新的草場水草，這種半遊牧式的移動天然地變成對邊州屯田、牧場與糧倉的襲擊；劫掠來的牲畜與人口既是食物，也是同漢地交易時的硬貨。於是這場戰鬥在官方檔案裏只是一次「寇邊」，在邊地則是年年都要重演的事。
causeEn: A frontier action of this kind usually has three layers of cause stacked on top of each other. The outermost is structural. After the Tang had broken the Turks and set up the Protectorate of the Jiedu, the northern frontier worked on the principle of holding the passes with towns: frontier prefectures, military towns and farms to keep the nomadic populations out of the interior, combined with markets, dependent prefectures and enrolment to win over the middle ground. The system worked, but it was expensive and it was inflexible; in a year of poor harvests or of quarrels among the clans, the defence had to be pulled in two directions at once, towards holding towns and towards marching out. The second layer is the immediate background of the year: during the Yifeng years the court was grinding against the Tibetans along the Qinghai and Liangzhou lines, and Pei Xingjian was ordered west with the Sasanian prince, so horses and attention were drawn to the western front, leaving the north and northeast open for the Khitans, and that rhythm can be read in the frontier notices of the Comprehensive Mirror for the fourth year of Yifeng. The third layer is the seasonal pressure of a tribal economy: between summer and autumn the Khitan herders had to move their horses and their people to new pastures and water, and such semi-nomadic movement naturally turned into raids on border farms, pastures and granaries; the livestock and people taken in such raids were both food and hard currency when traded with the settled districts. So in the official files this was a single border incursion, while on the ground it was something that happened again every year.
impact: 從長遠看，這場戰役在唐北方邊防上的意義並不算小。它延續並且不斷加固了唐初定下的「以城控塞」思路：州城的磚石、屯田的擴張、馬援的編制、烽燧的間距，都在儀鳳與其後的垂拱年間被一項項加固，換來的是北方邊線在接下來二十多年裡沒有出現崩盤式的失守，直到武周時期，契丹與靺鞨的壓力同時從幽州與營州兩個方向上來，整條北線才被扯成一團。對契丹本身，這類戰役既造成損失，也提供了經驗：他們學會了避開正面設防的大城，轉而打擊屯田點、糧倉與傳驛，學會了在得手不成時立刻脫離、在唐軍出城追擊時反手設伏。學會這一點的部眾，在後來百餘年裡逐步從劫掠的部落，變成可以在石堡城與幽州城下長期作戰的政權。當然，從史料層面看，這場戰役留下的痕跡極薄，只有零星奏報與通鑑的簡筆。這種薄本身就是唐代邊防的特徵：對多數邊州而言，與其說有一場戰役，不如說有一條持續了數百年的、被統計成幾行字的前線。
impactEn: In the longer run the significance of this campaign for Tang northern defence was not small. It carried forward and steadily hardened the principle set at the beginning of the dynasty, holding the passes with towns: the masonry of the prefecture walls, the expansion of the military farms, the establishment of the horses and the spacing of the beacon towers were all tightened one by one through the Yifeng and Chuigong years, and the price was that the northern line did not collapse in the two decades that followed, right up to the Wu Zhou period, when Khitan and Mohe pressure arrived simultaneously from the direction of Youzhou and from Yingzhou and the whole northern belt was pulled apart at last. For the Khitans themselves such campaigns cost them but also taught them: to avoid large towns that were firmly held and to strike instead at farm-points, granaries and courier stations; to break off instantly when the raid did not go, and to turn back and ambush when the Tang came out in pursuit. Clans that learned this over the following century and more gradually turned from raiding bands into a power capable of fighting a long war beneath Shibao and Youzhou. On the level of the record, of course, what survives of this campaign is very thin: a few scattered memorials and a line or two in the Mirror. That thinness is itself a feature of Tang frontier defence, which was less a series of battles than a standing line, continuous for centuries and summarised in a few lines of text.
result: 結局是唐軍守住了邊州，入侵的契丹部眾沒有能站住腳，最後退回草原；唐廷沒有為此調動大規模的反擊兵團，邊事在奏報之後迅速回到常態。所謂「朔州、黑山之戰」的結果，其實是一種體系的成功：不是靠一場決戰把敵人趕走，而是靠城、靠屯田、靠聯防、靠對方自己耗不起，把一次本可能演變成大規模戰爭的衝突，壓回成邊吏每月都要處理的小股越境。這也說明為什麼史書對它的記錄如此簡略：對唐廷而言，這不是一場需要記住勝負的戰役，而是一次被體制消化掉的日常摩擦。傳記有限，具體的斬獲數、俘虜數與受損器械數，正史都沒有留下可信記載；可以確定的只有三件事——時間在儀鳳四年，發生地在北方邊線，而唐方的守城體系沒有被突破。對後人而言，這場戰役最重要的意義，是它作為一個樣本，讓人看見唐代邊防如何用最少的動作，把無法避免的衝突收進日常。
resultEn: The outcome was that the Tang held the border prefecture and the Khitan parties who had come in could not establish themselves, eventually withdrawing to the steppe; the court did not commit a large counter-stroke force, and the frontier affair quickly returned to routine after the memorial was filed. The result of the "battle of Shuozhou and Heishan" was in truth a success of the system rather than of any engagement: not a decisive battle that drove the enemy away, but walls, farms, a linked alarm system and the enemy's own inability to afford to stay, which pressed what might have become a general war back down into the small incursions that frontier officials handled month after month. That is also why the histories record it so briefly: for the court this was not a battle whose outcome needed to be remembered, but a daily friction absorbed by the machinery of government. The record is limited; no reliable figures for kills, captives or damaged equipment survive. Three things can be stated with confidence: the time was the fourth year of Yifeng, the place was the northern frontier line, and the Tang defensive system was not breached. For later readers the value of the campaign lies in being a specimen, showing how Tang frontier defence folded an unavoidable conflict into the ordinary business of the day with the smallest possible expenditure of effort.
